kjv: I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles
mine: I am not in the least inferior to these super-apostles
note: hyperlian apostoloi is sarcastic, aimed at Paul's rivals in Corinth (11:13 "false apostles"); "the very chiefest apostles" suggests the Twelve. Also 12:11.

kjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ
mine: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus
note: TR adds "hemon" and "Christou"; absent from Sinaiticus, B.
